verses.text: The Burden of Tyre: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for it is laid waste—without house, without harbor! From the land of Kittim it has been revealed to them.

verses.text: Be still, O dwellers of the coastland, merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.

segments.text: Be still, O dwellers of the coastland, merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.

verses.text: And on great waters [is] the seed of Sihor; the harvest of the River [is] her revenue, and she is a marketplace of nations.

segments.text: And on great waters [is] the seed of Sihor; the harvest of the River [is] her revenue, and she is a marketplace of nations.

verses.text: Be ashamed, O Sidon, for the sea has spoken, the strength of the sea, saying: “I have not been pained and I have not brought forth children, and I have not nourished young men or brought up young women.”

verses.text: When the report [comes] to Egypt they will writhe in agony at the report of Tyre.

segments.text: When the report [comes] to Egypt they will writhe in agony at the report of Tyre.

verses.text: Pass over to Tarshish; Wail, O dwellers of the coastland.

segments.text: Pass over to Tarshish; Wail, O dwellers of the coastland.

verses.text: [Is] this your⁺ jubilant one, whose origin [is] from days of old? Her own feet carried her to settle far away.

segments.text: [Is] this your⁺ jubilant one, whose origin [is] from days of old? Her own feet carried her to settle far away.

verses.text: Who has taken counsel this against Tyre, the crowning one, whose merchants [are] princes; her traders [are] the honorable ones of the earth?

segments.text: Who has taken counsel this against Tyre, the crowning one, whose merchants [are] princes; her traders [are] the honorable ones of the earth?

verses.text: Yhwh of hosts has purposed it—to dishonor the pride of all glory, to shame all the honorable ones of the earth.

segments.text: Yhwh of hosts has purposed it—to dishonor the pride of all glory, to shame all the honorable ones of the earth.

verses.text: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; [there is] no girdle anymore.

segments.text: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; [there is] no girdle anymore.

verses.text: He has stretched out His hand over the sea, He has shaken the kingdoms. Yhwh has commanded against Canaan to destroy her strongholds.

segments.text: He has stretched out His hand over the sea, He has shaken the kingdoms. Yhwh has commanded against Canaan to destroy her strongholds.

verses.text: And He said, “You will not add again to exult, O oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. To Kittim arise, pass over—even there is no rest unto you.”

segments.text: And He said, “You will not add again to exult, O oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. To Kittim arise, pass over—even there is no rest unto you.”

verses.text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans—this people was not. Assyria has founded it for the desert creatures; they set up its towers, they raised up its palaces—He has appointed her to ruin.

verses.text: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your⁺ refuge has been destroyed!

segments.text: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your⁺ refuge has been destroyed!

verses.text: And it will come to pass in that day, [that] Tyre will be forgotten seventy years—as the days of one king. At the end of seventy years, it will come to pass to Tyre as the song of the harlot:

segments.text: And it will come to pass in that day, [that] Tyre will be forgotten seventy years—as the days of one king. At the end of seventy years, it will come to pass to Tyre as the song of the harlot:

verses.text: “Take a harp, go about the city, O forgotten harlot; make sweet melody, sing many a song, so that you may be remembered.”

segments.text: “Take a harp, go about the city, O forgotten harlot; make sweet melody, sing many a song, so that you may be remembered.”

verses.text: And it will come to pass at the end of seventy years, [that] YHWH will visit Tyre, and she will return to her hire and commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

segments.text: And it will come to pass at the end of seventy years, [that] YHWH will visit Tyre, and she will return to her hire and commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

verses.text: And her gain and her pay will be set apart for YHWH; it will not be stored up and not laid up, for unto those sitting before YHWH will be her gain, to eat to satisfaction, and for a surpassing covering.
